verdict.rationale: Supabase documents several isolated test environments. Branching spins off separate preview environments, including one per pull request, for testing changes without affecting production. The CLI runs the entire stack locally or in CI, with its own local MCP endpoint, and a hands-on probe confirmed headless `supabase init` scaffolds a local project with no login. The MCP server also exposes branching tools and a read-only mode for agents. Missing for 10: MCP branching tools are labeled experimental; no hands-on confirmation of `supabase start` or branch creation; community reports describe local development as buggy and a weak point for migrations; the evidence doesn't say how branch data is seeded or isolated.
